why: Issue #936. A state declares the selectors it measures, and one absent from a given screen has no box -- `screen.startup.unsupported-render` declares three and a pane state can declare five. Without the filter the caption reaches into a box that is not there. NOTE the shape of the kill: it THROWS rather than mis-captioning, so the three failures are one cause and not three independent signals -- every test whose fixture includes an unmeasured selector fails together. That is also what the regression would do in production, loudly, which is the better of the two failure modes.
